AereA is out now on XBOX Series X|S!

Return to the fragmented floating world of Aezir and step into the role of one of Great Maestro Guido’s disciples. Set out on a quest to recover the nine primordial instruments and restore balance to the broken island.

Explore diverse islands, complete quests, solve puzzles, battle powerful bosses inspired by musical instruments, and uncover the truth behind Aezir’s mysterious past.

Warframe | Iceblade of Narin Official Gameplay Trailer - Coming to September 23!
Witness a preview of the next Warframe update, featuring voiceover from actor Choi Han!

Atop the Yuvan Peak, where the Tenno mastered their Void powers, an icy monolith rises. Use its strength to beat back a new threat: the Entropic Eximus. Master the keen blade of the first female ice-themed Warframe, Narin. Defend and strike deftly with her swift rapier and deadly Abilities starting September 23. 

Engage in new six-player Glacial Defiance Missions and aid Cephalon Melica as you return to the Zariman once more! 

Instantly add a free Banshee Warframe when you log in after launch for a limited time until October 7. 

Iceblade of Narin arrives on platforms September 23!

Join 90M+ registered players in Warframe, a cooperative, free-to-play third-person looter shooter set in a constantly evolving sci-fi universe.

Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Launch Trailer
Onimusha: Way of the Sword, the all new entry in Capcom's swordplay action series, releases on Friday, September 4, 2026!
Become the Onimusha, Miyamoto Musashi, and prepare yourself for the intense duels that await!

https://www.xbox.com/games/store/onimusha-way-of-the-sword/9pjmhtrc9wkb

Demo available now!
Experience the exhilarating swordplay action and earn yourself the save data bonus!

- Footage represents a game still in development.
- Some footage was captured with enemy dismemberment death effects disabled.

Onimusha: Way of the Sword, an all-new entry in the Onimusha series, plunges the Oni Gauntlet wielding protagonist, Miyamoto Musashi into an early Edo-period Kyoto under siege by monstrous fiends known as Genma. Feel the ring of steel on steel as blades clash in tense back-and-forth duels. Cut down foes with authentic and satisfying swordplay. Awaken Oni Powers to pull off superhuman feats. All these elements combine to deliver an unprecedented swordplay action experience you will not want to miss.
